adjudicated_statement: Work over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero (or C) at (g,n)=(6,6). ATT-0112/CLM-0112-8 (Grauert; formation of pi_*L commuting with base change so that pi_*L is locally free of rank three; Zariski-locally trivial Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle A=P_S(pi_*L); reduced-support open U; finite etale S_6-ordering torsor Z=Ord(U)) is established over smooth finite-type scheme atlases of the fixed-target stack H^bal and does not transfer verbatim to a general etale scheme atlas S of Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2]. The packet convention is W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C, the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C; the construction therefore uses the odd twist O(5) on the target. Over such an S the tautological target is the P^1-bundle associated to the classifying PGL_2-torsor, i.e. a Severi-Brauer scheme of relative dimension one. Ordinary O_P(d) exists on that target if and only if d is even or the image of the torsor in Br(S)[2] vanishes (Lichtenbaum sequence; Kollár: O_P(1) exists as an ordinary line bundle iff the Severi-Brauer variety is isomorphic to projective space; on a non-split conic the ordinary Picard group is generated by O(2)). Hence W_5, L:=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, and pi_*L need not exist as ordinary (untwisted) sheaves on S, and Zariski-local triviality of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle is not licensed by citing CLM-0112-8 unchanged. This does not assert that the Brauer class is nonzero on every atlas of Hbar^bal, and does not assert that a general Severi-Brauer conic arises as a g^1_4 target. The relative complete linear system of the corresponding twisted invertible sheaf is a Severi-Brauer scheme of relative dimension two, so a dimension count 15+2=17 can be repaired at that level; alternatively, the classifying morphism to M_{6,6} is PGL_2-invariant (CLM-0112-7), so the image of the H^bal-level ordered reduced-support model of dimension 18+2=20 (FND-0181) factors through a stack quotient of dimension 20-3=17, consistent with dim Hbar^bal=18-3=15. Neither repair is supplied by citing CLM-0112-8, and neither proves equality dim Y=17. Attempts that need a 17-dimensional model must write one of these repairs (or an SL_2/GL_2 lift on which O(1) exists) rather than cite CLM-0112-8 unchanged. Compatible with FND-0181's proved bound dim Y<=20 and with CLM-0112-8 on its H^bal-atlas scope.
contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the finding does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Local contested passage, checked first in ATT-0121 and REV-0171: ATT-0121 Section 3 and CLM-0121-2 apply ATT-0112/CLM-0112-8 over a connected component of a smooth finite-type etale scheme atlas of Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2] to obtain a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle and dim Z=15+2=17. REV-0171 marks CLM-0121-2 unresolved precisely because CLM-0112-8 is confirmed only over smooth finite-type atlases of H^bal, and records the odd-twist/Brauer obstruction as the concrete reason. That citation-range defect is real and independent of whether dim Y<=17 can later be repaired. Compatible with CLM-0112-8 on its actual H^bal-atlas scope; with CLM-0112-2 and CLM-0112-7 (dimensions 18 and 15, PGL_2-invariance of the M_{6,6} point); with FND-0181, whose proved bound is dim Y<=20 from the H^bal-level 18+2 model and which explicitly does not cover equality dim Y=17; and with FND-0171, which takes Zariski-local triviality of A=P_S(pi_*L) as a hypothesis on a dimension-15 base rather than as a consequence of CLM-0112-8. Distinct from FND-0157, which warns that a general etale P^1-bundle or Severi-Brauer conic need not arise as a g^1_4 target: the present finding is only that the tautological target over an Hbar^bal atlas is the associated P^1-bundle of a PGL_2-torsor, whose class can obstruct ordinary O(5). Compatible with FND-0169, which includes etale atlases of Hbar^bal among bases carrying a geometric (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family without discharging ordinary O(5) or Zariski-local triviality of the Abel-Jacobi P^2. Independent primary checks. (1) Encyclopedia of Mathematics: a Brauer-Severi scheme over X is etale-locally P^n_X, equivalently a finitely presented proper flat morphism with geometric fibres projective spaces, classified by H^1(X,PGL_{n+1}). (2) Kollár arXiv:1606.04368v2, Baby Example 3 and Main Example 5 / Corollary 14: a conic with no rational point has no degree-1 line bundle; O_P(1) exists as an ordinary line bundle on a Severi-Brauer variety P iff P is isomorphic to projective space; in the non-split case the ordinary Picard group is generated by multiples of the canonical class, which on P^1 is O(-2). Section 6 and Definition 47: the complete linear system of a twisted line bundle is itself a Severi-Brauer variety, so projectivization of the twisted sheaf of sections is a PGL-form of projective space rather than a Zariski-locally trivial projective bundle. Theorem 81 records the same Euler sequence and Azumaya algebra for Severi-Brauer schemes over a base. (3) Wikipedia (Lichtenbaum): 0->Pic(X)->Z -delta-> Br(K)->Br(K)/(X)->0 with delta(1) the Brauer class of X, so if the class has order d then the least ordinary divisor degree is a multiple of d; for a relative P^1 this order divides 2, hence ordinary O(5) exists iff the class vanishes. These sources confirm the mechanism and the two repair routes (twisted linear system as a relative Severi-Brauer scheme of dimension two; PGL_2-quotient of the already-constructed 20-dimensional H^bal-level model) as standard, not as theorems already written in ATT-0121. Do not merge with FND-0181 or FND-0157. Promote from candidate; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source.
